agent_positioning.summary: Stingray is the market-data and hosted-rule partner for coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other SKILL.md-compatible hosts.
use_when: the task needs live crypto indexes or normalized entity news
the user names an ambiguous asset, ticker, venue, wallet, narrative, or prediction-market topic
a market thesis should become an inspectable alert rule
a rule should be backtested before it is trusted
monitoring should continue after the coding-agent session ends
the user wants delivery through linked Telegram, WhatsApp, web chat, notifications, or an opt-in public card
complements_generic_agents_by: resolving the right asset or market across venues
turning prose into typed alert definitions
running private historical replay with metrics
hosting alert rules on Stingray infrastructure
returning account-scoped state and delivery readiness
keeping market workflows inside a token-scoped API boundary
boundaries: no order placement or cancellation through the public skill
no billing, admin, webhook, guest, internal, tool-host, Slack install, or X link-claim routes
no API-token creation from an API-token-authenticated client
no public share card unless the user explicitly asks to share

capabilities.capability: Understand account readiness, onboarding, credits, usage, and linked delivery channels.
capabilities.example_prompt: What can my Stingray account do right now?

capabilities.capability: Explain when Stingray is the right partner for a coding agent and show high-value market workflows the account can run.
capabilities.example_prompt: Show me the best Stingray workflows I can delegate from Codex or Claude Code with this account.

capabilities.capability: Resolve the right asset, venue, entity, or market reference before downstream watchlist, portfolio, alert, or backtest work.
capabilities.example_prompt: Resolve ETH on Hyperliquid versus Binance Spot before you draft the alert, and tell me which market reference you used.

capabilities.capability: Research assets, tokens, projects, narratives, and market events through Stingray's live indexes and normalized entity news.
capabilities.example_prompt: Look up Chainlink, resolve the right asset entity, and summarize the latest source-backed news.

capabilities.capability: Curate the user's account watchlist after resolving stable asset identifiers.
capabilities.example_prompt: Find ETH and SOL, resolve the right entities, and add them to my watchlist.

capabilities.capability: Track portfolio positions for crypto, prediction-market, or equity assets.
capabilities.example_prompt: Add 0.25 BTC to my portfolio and then show my current positions.

capabilities.capability: Create and manage hosted typed rules that combine price, news, technical-analysis, and supported venue-specific conditions.
capabilities.example_prompt: Alert me if BTC drops 5% and there is negative news within 2 hours, but show the typed rule first.

capabilities.capability: Keep validated alert rules running on Stingray's hosted runtime after the coding-agent session ends.
capabilities.example_prompt: If my account is ready, create the alert on Stingray so it keeps monitoring and sends me Telegram notifications.

capabilities.capability: Read alert notifications and mark selected or all notifications as read.
capabilities.example_prompt: Show my unread alert notifications and mark the ones I choose as read.

capabilities.capability: Turn a thesis or alert draft into a private historical replay with trigger timing, quality metrics, and forward returns.
capabilities.example_prompt: Backtest a BTC breakout thesis over the last year, keep it private, and summarize how often the rule would have fired.

capabilities.capability: Mint an opt-in public share card from an existing backtest.
capabilities.example_prompt: Create a public share card for the backtest I just ran.

capabilities.capability: Use web, Telegram, or WhatsApp chats when the target channel is already linked, preserving market context across surfaces.
capabilities.example_prompt: Continue this BTC research in Telegram if my Telegram channel is linked.

capabilities.capability: Inspect or manage Telegram and WhatsApp delivery-channel links, and inspect X link status.
capabilities.example_prompt: Check whether Telegram and WhatsApp are linked and tell me what is blocking alert delivery.

capabilities.capability: Manage attribution, referral-code state, and public referral lookups.
capabilities.example_prompt: Create my referral code if I do not already have one.

capabilities.capability: List and revoke existing API tokens without creating new tokens.
capabilities.example_prompt: List my API tokens and help me revoke old integration tokens while keeping the current token active.

capabilities.capability: Report missing assets, signals, datasets, or reference mismatches back to the Stingray team.
capabilities.example_prompt: Ask Stingray to add this missing signal to the co-development backlog.

blocked_capabilities.capability: Create API tokens with an API token-authenticated client.
blocked_capabilities.reason: Token creation requires interactive registered auth.

blocked_capabilities.capability: Place orders, cancel orders, manage delegated wallets, or use Hyperliquid order-placement routes.
blocked_capabilities.reason: Delegated trading and value-transfer workflows require app or interactive-auth trust-ladder surfaces, not the public API-token skill.

blocked_capabilities.capability: Manage billing, admin, internal, webhook, guest, tool-host, Slack install, X link-claim, or public social posting routes.
blocked_capabilities.reason: These routes are outside the token-scoped agent surface.
